name: TCL Smart TV Pro (G09)
summary: TCL Smart TV Pro (G09) ships with TCL telemetry, content rows and preloaded apps. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with backup and undo.
intro: This TCL set, sold in Brazil with UK firmware, ships with TCL telemetry and analytics, content rows, ads and promos, and background services you do not need. It also has several preloaded apps. One app that looks like analytics is actually the broadcast interactive-TV engine, so it is not on the list.

The list was built for this firmware family and keeps the remote, input menu and mic keys working. TidyTV turns these apps off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything. keep: Live TV and HDMI playback (the TCL TV app)
The TCL input and source menu
Remote pairing and the mic hotkeys
The broadcast interactive-TV engine used in Brazil
notes: The TCL setup app is on the list and also handles channel scanning. Keep it on if you still need to scan channels.
Firmware updates come through Google Play Services on this set.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back on my TCL Smart TV Pro?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything in the app turns every app back on and puts the old home screen back in one tap. TidyTV only switches apps off, so nothing is ever deleted.

faq.q: Can I still scan for channels?
faq.a: Only if you keep the TCL setup app on, because it also handles channel installation. Switch it back on in the app before scanning.

faq.q: Does TidyTV delete anything on my TCL Smart TV Pro?
faq.a: No. It turns apps off with Android's own setting, saves a backup first and checks each one. You can turn any app back on with its switch.
